pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo telaṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.11: kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ kassa sāduṃ na ruccatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.12: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.13: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.18: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.21.1: yā pana bhikkhunī dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya paṭidesetabbaṃ tāya bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.22: gārayhaṃ ayye dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.1.23: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.2.4: pubbe mayaṃ ayye dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjāma tena no phāsu hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.2.5: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittanti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema tena no na phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānāya bhikkhuniyā dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd2:1.2.8: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:1.1.1: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya paṭidesetabbaṃ tāya bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:1.1.2: gārayhaṃ ayye dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.1.8: yassā vinā dadhinā na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.1.20: gokhīraṃ vā ajikākhīraṃ vā mahisakhīraṃ vā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ khīraṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.1.23: agilānā attano atthāya viññāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.2.1: agilānā agilānasaññā dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjati āpatti pāṭidesanīyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.2.2: agilānā vematikā dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjati āpatti pāṭidesanīyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.2.3: agilānā gilānasaññā dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjati āpatti pāṭidesanīyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd8:2.3.12: uddiṭṭhā kho ayyāyo aṭṭha pāṭidesanīyā dhammā.
